spec.name: plug
spec.query: is the MagSafe charger plugged into the laptop?
spec.task_summary: Top-down phone view of a desk with a MacBook on the right side. A MagSafe charging cable (flat rectangular magnetic connector, white or dark grey) may be attached to the laptop's MagSafe port on its left edge. A separate black USB-C cable with a round barrel connector is also plugged into the laptop and must be ignored.
visual_cues: yes: the flat rectangular MagSafe connector sits flush against the laptop's left edge, touching it (with or without a hand on it)
yes: a small green or amber LED glows on the MagSafe connector (it only lights when connected)
no: the MagSafe connector is away from the laptop (held in the air, lying on the desk, or out of frame) — a visible gap between connector and laptop edge
decoy: the black USB-C cable with a round metal barrel connector is always plugged in — it does not count

question.name: magsafe_connected
question.instructions: Is the MagSafe charger connector plugged into the laptop? The MagSafe connector is the flat, rectangular magnetic plug (white or dark grey) on the end of a charging cable. Answer yes only if it sits flush against the laptop's edge with no gap. A small green or amber LED glowing on the connector means it is connected. A hand touching or holding it does not matter: judge only whether it is seated. IGNORE the black USB-C cable with a round barrel-shaped metal connector, which is always plugged in.

edge_cases: The USB-C cable (round barrel connector) is plugged in: that alone is NOT a yes
Hand covering the connector while it touches the laptop: yes
Connector a few millimetres from the edge (mid-insertion): no
MagSafe connector not visible at all: no
LED visible and lit on the MagSafe connector: yes
